title: Kenworth K200 Aluminium FUPS Bullbar Wagga Style #22
description: Kenworth K200 FUPS high tensile aluminium Bullbar. Three mains, one piece 76mm cross tubes through drilled uprights and recessed into drilled outer uprights. Driving light mount to suit application. Lower front flap. Front mudflap mounts are standard. Optional indicator repeater lights to outer uprights. Bullbar can be custom built to your specifications.
